description: This script performs benchmarking and comparison of CLI startup times and memory usage against baseline data. It reads configuration options, manages report files, executes benchmark commands, processes results, and determines regressions based on specified thresholds.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a number representing milliseconds to a string with one decimal place followed by 'ms'.

methods.name: formatMb
methods.description: Formats a number representing megabytes to a string with one decimal place followed by 'MB'.

methods.name: resolveCurrentReportPath
methods.description: Determines the path to the current report file, generating a new report if needed.

methods.name: indexCases
methods.description: Creates a Map of report cases indexed by their ID.
